headline: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday directed authorities to cancel the licences of petrol pumps that fail to facilitate registered beneficiaries of the PM's Fuel Relief Programme, under which 15,519,282 citizens have registered, Dawn reports.

card.desc: 15,519,282 shehri Fuel Relief Programme mein register ho chuke

caption:
Subsidy na dene wale petrol pumps ke licence cancel honge!
Dawn ke mutabiq PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Thursday ko hukum diya ke jo petrol pumps PM Fuel Relief Programme ke registered beneficiaries ko sahulat nahi dete, un ke licence cancel kiye jayen. Meeting ko bataya gaya ke ab tak 15,519,282 shehri register ho chuke hain aur 4 November tak Rs28.6 billion ki payments ho chuki hain.
